text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

'Sup. What's with the deep sigh? On a 
sweets restriction or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To all the reporters, I promise a 
race worthy of the Mejiro name—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-Nature-san? M-My apologies. I have 
had so many interviews lately.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, no! It's on me for suddenly 
calling out to you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Say! Mind keeping me company for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A batting cage...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Got that vintage feel, right? I kinda find 
these retro places relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You might be busy, but even just one pitch 
is fine, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I do not have the luxury of 
idling away my time... Well, as you 
offered, just one swing and I shall—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hah! ...O-Oh my?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aww, too bad. You were super close to 
hitting that one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just one more time! This next time, I 
shall definitely hit it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness! Am I off my game today? I find 
myself rushing my swing...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still close, though! Keep your eye on the 
ball till the very end. Don't look away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am gradually beginning to recall the 
sensation. Just like dashing out the 
moment the gates open...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Keep the rhythm... and swing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! It rolled away! Do take a look, 
Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! So close! Just a bit more and it 
would have been a home run!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Didn't expect you to get so into it! Wait, 
McQueen, do you secretly visit places like 
this often?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kh! N-No, ohoho...! Rather, your own 
skills are truly impressive, Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ahaha, well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I come here every now and then, like on 
days when I lose a race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I get stuck in a rut thinking 
stuff like, 'Man, I really let everyone 
down.'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Coming here helps me hit the reset button 
on everything around me and just face 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... that is quite true, isn't it... 
Focusing solely on one's own growth, 
concentrating, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For a name to shine, the one bearing it 
must live up to it... is that not so, desu 
wa?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I truly appreciate your kindness. Um, do 
you happen to have plans after this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk in the park on a day 
off, I spotted Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: People sure are mysterious...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... Did I say that out loud? Nah, I 
was just talking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how even sparkling, 
brilliant horse girls end up fretting over 
stuff like me.
choice_data_list: I think you're shining bright too, though
I think you sparkle just as brightly
What kind of worries do you have...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how even sparkling, 
brilliant horse girls end up fretting over 
stuff like me.
choice_data_list: I think you're shining bright too, though
I think you sparkle just as brightly
What kind of worries do you have...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As if! Compared to those jewel-like girls, 
I don't hold a candle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I believe you are a wonderful horse girl 
yourself, Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Caring for others is a talent in its own 
right. And this Hachimii is a token of my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A talent?! N-No way, aren't you 
exaggerating a bit much?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll gladly take the sentiment. 
Thanks a bunch for the Hachimii~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Secret. I've got my worries, but I'm 
not telling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be having a fascinating 
conversation. May I join in, if you do not 
mind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just as you cheered me up, I would like to 
be of help to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what?! N-No way, it's really not the 
kind of worry you go around blabbing to 
others...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If it's about returning the favor, this 
Hachimii is more than enough! Thanks for 
treating me.
